OPTICAL SENSOR: CAMERA • Screen with (order of 10^6 or more) photosensitive elements called pixels (PIXEL = PICture ELement) - Optical  electric transducers • Optical system enables the selection of a single direction of incoming light at each element • Electric circuits that collect the signal generated at the pixels - 30-60 frames per second (even more in special cameras)
